claims: Ty Gibbs was born on October 4, 2002.
Ty Gibbs is a NASCAR Cup Series driver for Joe Gibbs Racing.
Ty Gibbs drives the No. 54 Toyota Camry XSE.
Ty Gibbs is the 2022 Xfinity Series champion.
Ty Gibbs is the 2021 ARCA champion.
Ty Gibbs achieved his first career Cup Series win at Bristol Motor Speedway in April 2026.
Ty Gibbs' first career Cup Series win was after 131 starts.
Ty Gibbs is the grandson of Joe Gibbs.
Joe Gibbs is a NASCAR team owner.
Joe Gibbs is an NFL Hall of Famer.
Ty Gibbs is the son of the late Coy Gibbs.
Ty Gibbs won his first Cup race in overtime at the 2026 Food City 500 at Bristol.
Ty Gibbs had a victory lane celebration with his grandfather after winning the 2026 Food City 500.
Ty Gibbs won his first career NASCAR Xfinity Series start in 2021.
Ty Gibbs moved to the Cup Series full-time in 2023.
Ty Gibbs earned Rookie of the Year honors in the Cup Series.
Ty Gibbs has frequently cited Darlington Raceway as one of his favorite tracks.
As of April 2026, Ty Gibbs is a driver for Joe Gibbs Racing in the NASCAR Cup Series.
